title: Guardian — Server Overview
description: Operational overview of a guardian-server's Prometheus metrics. See docs/guides/observability/ and spec/api.md (Metrics Endpoint) for the taxonomy.

panels.title: Build
panels.description: version · profile · git_commit from guardian_build_info

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: guardian_accounts — total configured accounts (refreshed asynchronously)

panels.title: Proposals in flight
panels.description: guardian_proposals_in_flight — pending multisig proposals

panels.title: Refresh staleness
panels.description: Seconds since the last successful slow-aggregate refresh. High = stale gauges.

panels.title: HTTP req rate
panels.description: Total HTTP requests/sec across all routes

panels.title: HTTP 5xx %
panels.description: Share of HTTP responses with a 5xx status

panels.title: Request rate by route
panels.description: Route labels are templates (e.g. /dashboard/accounts/{account_id}); unmatched paths collapse into route="unmatched".

panels.title: Errors by code (non-ok)
panels.description: Unrouted/unknown methods collapse into service="unknown" to keep cardinality bounded.

panels.title: RPC rate by operation / outcome
panels.description: Outbound calls to the Miden node — the dependency the server's availability hangs on.

panels.title: Storage op rate by operation / outcome
Storage op p95 latency by operation
DB pool connections by pool
panels.description: storage and metadata pools are sized and saturated independently (postgres builds).

panels.title: DB pool pending acquires by pool
panels.description: Sustained nonzero = pool exhaustion (tasks waiting for a connection).

panels.title: Run duration p95
panels.description: A full pass over all accounts with pending candidates (extended buckets to ~5m).

panels.title: Candidate outcomes
panels.description: canonicalized / retried / discarded / grace_deferred

panels.title: Rotations by outcome
panels.description: Walks of the fleet per hour: completed, or partial when some accounts could not be checked (they wait for the next rotation). A rotation takes a little over GUARDIAN_RELEASE_SWEEP_ROTATION_SECONDS (6 h by default), longer for a fleet too large for it at the rate cap; none for twice that means no replica holds the release_sweep lease.

panels.title: Account findings by outcome
panels.description: Per-account release sweep findings per hour. released is a switch the push path never recorded; own_key_mismatch above zero means this server's ack key changed (accounts bound to a key it no longer holds); storage_opaque counts private accounts whose chain state moved with nothing on this server explaining it.

panels.title: Deltas submitted by kind
panels.description: direct vs proposal_commit

panels.title: Proposal events
panels.description: created / signed / finalized

panels.title: Deltas by status
panels.description: candidate / canonical / discarded (gauge, refreshed asynchronously)

panels.title: Account creation rate by kind
panels.description: miden / evm — counter complement of the guardian_accounts gauge

panels.title: Operator auth, rate limiting & refresher health
Rate-limit rejections by type and transport
panels.description: burst / sustained, http / grpc

panels.title: Metrics refresh failures
panels.description: Failed slow-aggregate refreshes — gauges left stale on each.
